_comment: THE SEED PAYMENT SPLIT (MTG_CYCLE_SEED_PAY_SPLIT, ledger Q61): the cyclone_cycle_surplus_before_cast board with THREE
Mountains + four Islands. Without the split the line is unfindable at any budget: the seed's {2} is paid before its
continuation exists and the payer spends Mountains, so the other Cyclone's {R}{R} cannot be paid. With the split the
seed's generic is a searched pin (RR / RU / UU here; the hand-demand split, which leaves {R}{R}, first) -> cycle
Cyclone #1, draw the Wraith, cast Cyclone #2, cycle the Wraith -> Emrakul -> round 3.
